headline: Manchester City face striker dilemma as Erling Haaland is rated a doubt
standfirst: Manchester City are weighing up attacking solutions ahead of their upcoming fixture as star striker Erling Haaland remains a doubt.
keyPoints: Erling Haaland has scored in six consecutive top-flight matches for Manchester City.
The striker missed a media-open training session and will be assessed following a fitness check.
Manager Maresca stated that Phil Foden is among the alternative options to fill the central role.

sections.heading: Striker concerns ahead of fixture
paragraphs: Manchester City head into their upcoming fixtures facing potential selection headaches in the attacking department. Star forward Erling Haaland, who recently reached a milestone of 100 non-penalty Premier League goals faster than any other player, is currently a doubt to feature. The Norwegian international has been in stellar form, scoring in six consecutive top-flight games to help push his side to the summit of the league table from their opening seven matches.

Manager Maresca indicated that his talisman "can be available" against AEK, though his final status depends on an evaluation following training. However, the forward was absent from a training session that was open to media observation, leaving team planners to contemplate alternative tactical setups for the squad.

sections.heading: Exploring attacking alternatives
paragraphs: The club's depth in the centre-forward position has previously been tested following summer departures and injuries. With Divin Mubama having joined Southampton on loan and Ghanaian player Semenyo facing a lengthy absence of up to 13 matches, natural replacements are thin on the ground. This leaves the coaching staff looking towards versatile squad members to step into the advanced role if needed.

Among the solutions discussed by the technical team is midfielder Phil Foden, who recently ended a goal drought in the Premier League. While Foden has experience operating in that advanced area of the pitch, the coaching staff maintain that Haaland remains their primary choice for the number nine role when fit. Other tactical variations previously utilised by the club include deploying Iliman Ndiaye or utilising Rayan Cherki in a false nine capacity.

socialSummary: Manchester City weigh up attacking options as star striker Erling Haaland faces a late fitness assessment.
